predecessors.name: Shunten and Eiso dynasties (Okinawa)
predecessors.text: the north of Okinawa Island: 'Hokuzan first came into being in 1314 when Tamagusuku inherited the role of head chieftain'

successors.name: Chūzan
successors.text: conquered by Shō Hashi of Chūzan in 1416: 'Nakijin castle fell, and the king and his closest vassals committed suicide'

ledger.x: 1314: Hokuzan arises at Nakijin as one of the three kingdoms of Okinawa.
1416: Shō Hashi of Chūzan attacks Hokuzan.

wars.name: Chūzan's conquest of Hokuzan
wars.outcome: Chūzan victory: after three anji defected, Shō Hashi took Nakijin Castle and the Hokuzan king and his closest vassals killed themselves; Hokuzan ended.

certainty.note: A castle-lord realm of districts (magiri) with no recorded frontier; the Chūzan and Nanzan borders are approximate.
